experiment: E5c (2026-09-28): action-expert time by model component, from the committed E5 nsys runs -- derived, no new measurement
inputs_note: the nsys .sqlite exports stay local (never committed, protocol §3.5); their parent run directories and meta are committed
method: per NVTX range: CUDA runtime calls in the range joined to their kernels by correlationId (CUDA-graph replays included); each kernel assigned to a component by name (bench/e5_expert_components.py docstring); kernel time per component. Times are under nsys (profiled). The span/idle columns are NOT valid for runs whose graphs execute asynchronously after the range (pi0_best, pi05_best): kernels of other work can fall in the span; use the per-component kernel times.
